approveMilestone(uint256).details: Normal happy path — no dispute fee is charged here

cancelEscrow().details: Case 1 (not funded): just marks as cancelled — no funds to return.      Case 2 (funded): refunds all PENDING milestones to the buyer.      Reverts if any milestone is SUBMITTED or DISPUTED — active work must be resolved first.

claimDisputeTimeout(uint256).details: Safety net against an inactive or malicious platform holding funds hostage.      Buyer always gets the refund — if no one resolves the dispute, seller loses by default.

params._autoApprovalDays: Days before seller can auto-claim a submitted milestone
params._correctionWindowDays: Days seller has to resubmit after a buyer-opened dispute
params._disputeTimeoutDays: Days before either party can trigger a dispute timeout
params._milestoneAmounts: Array of amounts for each milestone
params._platform: Address of the platform (dispute resolver, fee receiver)
params._token: Address of the payment token (e.g. USDC)

fund().details: Important: this contract assumes exactly `totalAmount` arrives.      Fee-on-transfer tokens (e.g. some versions of USDT) charge a fee during transfer      and deliver less than expected — this breaks the accounting and causes later      payouts to revert. Never approve such tokens in the factory whitelist.

resolveDispute(uint256,uint256).details: sellerAward = how much goes to the seller (platform decides this).      Whatever is left (after dispute fee) goes to the buyer.      The dispute fee (1%) is always taken from the total pot — it's the cost of arbitration.      The normal platform fee (FEE_BPS) is only charged on the seller's portion.      If sellerAward is 0 (buyer wins entirely), only the dispute fee is taken — no platform fee.      If the buyer opened the dispute, the platform must wait for the 7-day correction window      to expire before resolving — this gives the seller a chance to fix the issue first.

resubmitDuringDispute(uint256,bytes32).details: Only available when the buyer opened the dispute — gives seller a chance to fix the issue      before the platform needs to step in. Resets the milestone back to SUBMITTED.

sellerEscalate(uint256,bytes32).details: Use this when the seller believes their work is correct and does not want to resubmit.      Sets disputeOpenedBy to SELLER so admin can resolve immediately without waiting.

DISPUTE_FEE_BPS().notice: Extra fee taken only when the platform resolves a dispute (1% = 100 bps)

acceptProject().notice: Seller accepts the project — required before the buyer can fund

approveMilestone(uint256).notice: Buyer approves a submitted milestone and releases funds to the seller

cancelEscrow().notice: Buyer cancels the escrow and reclaims funds from unstarted milestones

cancelled().notice: Whether this escrow has been permanently closed by the buyer.         Once true, no new funds can be deposited and no new work can be submitted.         This prevents funds from being locked forever if a project never starts,         and allows the buyer to reclaim funds from unstarted milestones.

claimAutoApproval(uint256).notice: Seller claims funds after the auto-approval deadline has passed without buyer action

claimDisputeTimeout(uint256).notice: Either party can trigger this if the platform has not resolved a dispute in time

constructor.notice: Sets up a new escrow with all parties, token, fee, and milestones

fund().notice: Buyer deposits the full amount (sum of all milestones) into the escrow

funded().notice: Whether the buyer has deposited funds into this escrow

milestoneCount().notice: Returns the total number of milestones in this escrow

openDispute(uint256,bytes32).notice: Buyer or seller opens a dispute on a submitted milestone

rejectProject().notice: Seller rejects the project — cancels the escrow before any funds are locked

resolveDispute(uint256,uint256).notice: Platform resolves a dispute by deciding how much the seller receives

resubmitDuringDispute(uint256,bytes32).notice: Seller submits corrected work during a buyer-opened dispute (7-day correction window)

sellerAccepted().notice: Whether the seller has accepted this project — required before buyer can fund

sellerEscalate(uint256,bytes32).notice: Seller escalates a buyer-opened dispute directly to admin — skips the correction window

submitMilestone(uint256,bytes32).notice: Seller submits proof of delivery for a milestone

totalAmount().notice: Total amount locked in this escrow (sum of all milestone amounts)
